story.title: My Story
story.description: I am a product engineer from Czechia who loves fantasy, values extreme autonomy, and enjoys building things that make sense, without unnecessary bullshit. I recently co-founded a startup where I built the entire scalable architecture from scratch; from edge technologies like Vue & Nuxt or React & Next on the frontend to the database, infrastructure, and even the business model.

workflow.title: Workflow & Architecture
workflow.description: My workflow is heavily AI-assisted. I like setting up worktrees with AI agents (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, v0) and delegating syntax-level work to them. This allows me to deliver results much faster, while my pipeline ensures that the output is safe for production right after deployment. Of course, I still validate important commits manually.

principles.title: Core Principles
principles.description: I value freedom and extreme autonomy above all else. Agile iterations take precedence over bureaucratic bullshit, with a strict focus on results and real impact.

learning.title: Continuous Improvement
learning.description: Whether it's coding, business, or lifestyle, constant self-improvement and pushing my own boundaries is my daily routine.
